status: synthetic PTS indexes (Sample), not field evidence; 'assert' values are hand-derived from the half-up rule in docs/research/studio/multicam-sync.md sections 5.2-5.5 and 8.2-8.3

cases.why: 30 fps CFR at timescale 600 into a 30 fps proxy: the identity table
60 fps to 30: every odd frame sits on a tie (k + 1/2) and rounds up into the next slot, so slot k keeps frame 2k, the one at its instant
120 fps to 30: slot k shows the last frame rounding into it, 4k + 1, not the nearest frame 4k (the observed FFmpeg rule; analysis keeps original PTS anyway)
24 fps into a 30 fps film: one slot in five holds the previous frame; even frames land on ties (frame 2 at 2.5 slots rounds up to 3)
25 fps (PAL phone) into a 30 fps film: slots 3, 9, ... hold a frame; no ties
30 into a 60 fps film duplicates every frame, so the proxy is labelled upconverted (the angle shows '30 fps source')
Mixed rates: a 30000/1001 angle in a 30 fps film runs 1000 ppm slow; frame 500 lands exactly on 500.5 and rounds up, so slot 500 holds frame 499
Mixed rates the other way: a 30 fps angle in a 30000/1001 film drops one frame (500) in 600; track timescale 30000, 1001 ticks a frame
30000/1001 at timescale 30000 into a 30000/1001 proxy: the identity
25 fps into a 25 fps film: track timescale lcm(25, 1000) = 1000, 40 ticks a frame
VFR: every PTS jitters by up to 3 ticks of 600 (5 ms); jitter under half a frame never changes the selection
VFR with a dropped-frame burst: six frames (nominal 40-45, 200 ms) never arrived; slots 40-45 hold original frame 39 and the clock does not slip
Android-style 90 kHz timescale with jitter up to 600 ticks (6.7 ms) and eight dropped frames (nominal 20-27)
One late frame lands exactly halfway (210 = 10.5 frames): it rounds up to slot 11, where frame 11 replaces it, so slot 10 holds frame 9 and frame 10 is never shown
A capture stall then a catch-up burst: frames 15-17 arrive 10 ms apart after a gap, slots 15-17 hold frame 14, frame 15 is replaced by 16 in slot 18, and later frames shift by two slots
An original whose first frame is at PTS 1200 (edit list): the proxy still starts at zero and the run keeps the original PTS

S12: VFR + rotation 90 + HLG HDR: rotation baked once (3840x2160 shows as 1080x1920, no display rotation left), tone-mapped with the declared zscale method; frame 30 is on a tie and slot 30 holds frame 29
Rotation 270 SDR 1920x1080: a portrait 1080x1920 proxy, no tone map
Rotation 180 keeps landscape: 1920x1080, rotation baked, no swap
PQ HDR 3840x2160 into a 1920-wide SDR proxy with the libplacebo method declared
A 4:3 1440x1080 source scaled to a 1920 long edge: 1920x1440, never cropped or padded
1366x768 to a 1920 long edge: 768 x 1920 / 1366 = 1079.47, rounded half-up to the even 1080
S4: the mixed 29.97/30 case selected with half-even ties (Python round): frame 500 rounds to slot 500, so slot 500 shows 500 instead of 499; the frame-selection test fails
S4 at 60 to 30: half-even rounds frame 1 (0.5) down, so slot 0 shows frame 1
S4 on a VFR tie: half-even keeps frame 10 (10.5 to 10) in slot 10
Ties down at 24 to 30: frame 2 (2.5) stays in slot 2, which should hold frame 1
Choosing the nearest frame to each instant is not the rule: at 120 to 30 it picks frame 0 for slot 0, where the rule (and FFmpeg) shows frame 1
The proxy shows the right frames but the emitted table was computed with half-even: the table no longer matches the decoded IDs 100% (slot 500 says 500, the ID is 499)
An HDR original with no declared tone-map method is refused
An SDR original is not tone-mapped
Presentation timestamps out of order (decode order leaked in) are refused
An HDR flag needs an HLG or PQ transfer
endPts must come after the last frame
A 4:2:0 proxy needs even dimensions
A quarter-turn proxy left landscape (1920x1080) had its rotation dropped or applied as display metadata only
A 600 track timescale is not lcm(30, 1000) = 3000
A 30 fps source in a 60 fps proxy must be labelled upconverted
